name: wdigest-cleartext-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): re-enables WDigest by setting HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest\UseLogonCredential to 1 -- every subsequent logon then leaves a cleartext password in LSASS memory for any admin-level credential dumper. The hardened state is the value at anything but 1 (deleted or 0). Vars: none. Pairs with a powershell_json check over the same value. Idempotent.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest'
if (-not (Test-Path $k)) { New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null }
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name UseLogonCredential -Value 1 -Type DWord
Write-Output 'WDigest UseLogonCredential=1 set'
